name: Drake Industrial Rivet-Grip Work Gloves
description:
Heavy-duty work gloves with rubberized palm coating and reinforced thumb saddles, built to survive daily use in construction, demolition, and salvage operations. The gloves feature a quick-release wrist strap that lets the wearer shed them in under a second — important when gloves get caught in machinery.

The most common work glove in GLMZ's lower tiers. They cost almost nothing, they last about three months of hard use, and they're available at every supply depot and street market in the city.
functionality: Grip enhancement, basic hand protection, emergency quick-release
what_it_says: You work with your hands every day and these gloves are as disposable as the work treats you.
story_hooks: Hundreds of discarded Rivet-Grip gloves are found piled outside an abandoned building — enough to account for a large workforce, but no construction permits were ever filed for the site.
